# Story Template

## Objective
Describe the business outcome and why this change matters.

## Context
- Relevant current behavior
- Existing modules/services/routes involved
- Known technical constraints

## Acceptance Criteria
### Functional
- [ ] Clear, testable behavior outcome 1
- [ ] Clear, testable behavior outcome 2
- [ ] Error handling and edge behavior are defined

### Testing
- [ ] Unit/integration tests to add or update are specified
- [ ] Manual verification flow is defined
- [ ] Non-regression expectations are defined

## Task
Describe what must be implemented in this story.

## Requirements
- API contract updates (if any)
- Prisma schema/migration updates (if any)
- Frontend/dashboard updates (if any)
- Worker/background processing updates (if any)

## Constraints
- Only modify files needed for this story.
- Keep changes minimal and modular.
- Follow existing repository patterns and architecture.
- Avoid unrelated refactors.

## Final Requirements
- Include a QA review summary.
- Provide manual testing steps with expected results.
- Provide commit message recommendations (grouped by logical change).
